summary: Kerb backing onto a tennis court and lawn, where cars already park.
reasons: Backs onto tennis court and open lawn

drivers.seclusion: Own side is a tennis court and lawn; houses across the road are about 15 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along this kerb, so there is room to pull in; stay clear of the sign at the end.
drivers.convention: Cars and a boat trailer park here, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time at both ends of the stretch; stay in the middle
Slope about 2% at best section; 16% max further up
sun_shade: Mostly open, with some shade from the trees on the tennis court side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the tennis court owners object

best_section.where: Ivy Street south kerb, alongside the private tennis court
